      outputs, examples, version history) to match the code.
- [ ] Script `.NOTES` version/date and version history are bumped and match the `.md` file.
- [ ] Root [README.md](../README.md) contents table updated (version, description) if applicable.
- [ ] [wiki/Home.md](../wiki/Home.md) updated if applicable.
